area: UGS auth layer and the DI root (AppManager bindings)
summary: The AuthenticationServiceFacade binding now hands out one shared facade per Play (AuthenticationServiceFacade.Shared) and ResetStartupState keeps an in-flight sign-in
why: AppManager's bindings install into two Reflex containers, so two facades existed and the Authentication scene could start a second UGS sign-in beside the boot one (already signing in); other pure services are still duplicated per container
